meta.express_rule: fewer rounds at the same per-round dose; never a faster clock
meta.micro_rule: two rounds of the first two movements; no intensity compensation

workouts.name: EMOM — Dumbbell Base 20
workouts.description: Accessible full-body EMOM that builds repeatable muscular output without race-style modality integration.
workouts.coaching_notes: Choose loads that preserve 15-25s rest each minute. Do not chase failure.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Complete the work in ~35-45s; use the remainder of each minute as rest.

workouts.name: EMOM — Lower Body 24
workouts.description: Lower-body muscular endurance using simple squat, lunge and step patterns with controlled clock pressure.
workouts.coaching_notes: Local leg fatigue is intended; movement breakdown is not. Scale reps before load.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Preserve smooth reps and finish each work minute with recoverable time remaining.

workouts.name: EMOM — Upper Body 24
workouts.description: Push-pull upper-body endurance with enough rest to sustain quality across six cycles.
workouts.coaching_notes: Avoid early failure. Reps should remain within 1-3 reps of the opening round.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Use loads that keep every minute repeatable.

workouts.name: EMOM — Kettlebell Work Capacity 20
workouts.description: Kettlebell muscular endurance centered on repeatable ballistic and squat output.
workouts.coaching_notes: The clock creates repeatability, not urgency. Reduce reps if rest disappears.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Maintain crisp swing mechanics and unbroken submaximal sets.

workouts.name: EMOM — Bodyweight Density 24
workouts.description: Equipment-free muscular endurance with simple patterns and sustainable repetition.
workouts.coaching_notes: Leave reps in reserve every minute. Shorten the crawl or reduce reps before form degrades.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Keep all sets submaximal and technically consistent.

workouts.name: EMOM — Dumbbell Push-Pull 24
workouts.description: Repeatable dumbbell push-pull endurance with trunk and grip support.
workouts.coaching_notes: Do not turn this into a max-rep test. The final round should resemble the first.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Select loads that remain stable through all six rounds.

workouts.name: EMOM — Squat + Carry 20
workouts.description: Simple loaded muscular endurance emphasizing legs, trunk and grip.
workouts.coaching_notes: Use moderate loads. Continuous high-quality accumulation is the target.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Finish work with enough time to reset before the next minute.

workouts.name: EMOM — Power Endurance 18
workouts.description: Shorter technical EMOM for athletes who can sustain power-oriented dumbbell work without losing mechanics.
workouts.coaching_notes: Power quality governs loading. This is muscular endurance, not a conditioning sprint.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Every minute on the minute: one movement per minute, in order. Keep every set crisp; stop adding load once rep speed meaningfully drops.

workouts.name: Metcon — Dumbbell 5s
workouts.description: Full-body dumbbell metcon where local muscular fatigue, not running or transitions, is the primary limiter.
workouts.coaching_notes: Use one sustainable loading strategy. Avoid failure and keep round times within ~15%.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Rest 60s after each round.

workouts.name: Metcon — 12-10-8-6
workouts.description: Descending-rep muscular endurance with simple loaded and bodyweight patterns.
workouts.coaching_notes: Break sets before failure. The ladder should feel progressively more sustainable, not frantic.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Descending ladder, 12-10-8-6 reps. Rest as needed to preserve clean sets.

workouts.name: Metcon — Lower Body Chipper
workouts.description: Lower-body chipper built around accumulated squat, lunge and step volume rather than race integration.
workouts.coaching_notes: Use manageable chunks from the start. Do not save all breaks for late-stage failure.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Complete in order. Partition each movement as needed; quality remains the constraint.

workouts.name: Metcon — Upper Body Chipper
workouts.description: Upper-body push-pull volume challenge emphasizing sustainable muscular output.
workouts.coaching_notes: Submaximal chunks are the intended strategy. Keep shoulder mechanics clean.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Complete in order. Partition from the beginning to avoid muscular failure.

workouts.name: Metcon — Kettlebell Ladder
workouts.description: Kettlebell ladder combining ballistic, squat and press endurance without cardio-machine dependence.
workouts.coaching_notes: Do not sacrifice ballistic mechanics to finish a rung unbroken.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Ascending ladder, 4-6-8-10-12 reps. Rest 30-60s between rungs as needed.

workouts.name: Metcon — Bodyweight 20
workouts.description: Minimal-equipment muscular endurance using a repeatable bodyweight circuit.
workouts.coaching_notes: Score completed rounds plus reps, but pacing and repeatability take priority over speed.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: As many rounds as possible in 20 minutes. Move steadily; stop sets before failure.

workouts.name: Metcon — Dumbbell Complex Endurance
workouts.description: Technical dumbbell muscular endurance using integrated movements at deliberately submaximal loads.
workouts.coaching_notes: Load for clean movement combinations, not maximal strength. Preserve the same movement standard each round.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Rest 75s after each round.

workouts.name: Metcon — Carry Builder
workouts.description: Carry-dominant muscular endurance emphasizing grip, trunk and leg fatigue resistance.
workouts.coaching_notes: Carry posture and grip quality govern load. Avoid racing the transitions.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Rest 45-60s after each round.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Atlas
workouts.description: Long-form PIVOT benchmark for total-body muscular endurance using common dumbbell and bodyweight movements.
workouts.coaching_notes: Benchmark consistency matters more than maximal pace. Use the same movement standards on retest.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Record total time and loading for future comparison.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Forge
workouts.description: Loaded benchmark emphasizing repeated squat, press, pull and carry output.
workouts.coaching_notes: Choose loads that permit all six rounds without technical failure.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Rest only as needed; record total time and loads.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Long Haul
workouts.description: High-volume benchmark designed to test sustained muscular output with minimal equipment.
workouts.coaching_notes: Plan breaks before failure. This is a volume benchmark, not a test of reckless unbroken sets.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Complete in order. Partition movements as needed; record total time.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Iron Mile
workouts.description: Carry-centered PIVOT benchmark for grip, trunk and lower-body muscular endurance; no running required.
workouts.coaching_notes: Maintain carry posture and repeatable chunks. Grip failure should not force unsafe movement.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Record total time and loads.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Anvil
workouts.description: Technical dumbbell benchmark combining integrated movements with foundational muscular endurance.
workouts.coaching_notes: Use a load that preserves integrated-movement quality for the entire benchmark.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Record total time and dumbbell load.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Groundwork
workouts.description: Equipment-free benchmark for repeatable bodyweight muscular endurance.
workouts.coaching_notes: Scale reps before movement quality changes. Retests should use the same scaling.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Record total time; preserve movement standards.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Stronghold
workouts.description: Upper-body benchmark with sustained push, pull, grip and trunk output.
workouts.coaching_notes: Keep pushing and pulling volume balanced. Avoid muscular failure early.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Record total time and loads.

workouts.name: PIVOT Hero — Redline
workouts.description: High-demand PIVOT benchmark for athletes with established dumbbell power-movement competency.
workouts.coaching_notes: Technical quality is the stop rule. This benchmark is not appropriate outside the athlete's technical-capacity envelope.

blocks.title: Main
blocks.instructions: Rest only as needed to preserve power mechanics; record total time and load.
